subject: Penetration report — upload/playbook & evidence mapping for GRC portal (BlueOak)
messages:
From: PenTest Operations <ops@redcapsec.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: security@blueoak.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: BlueOak — final PT package and upload questions

Hi Grace / Vanessa,

We completed the final penetration test for BlueOak on 2027-10-31. Per BlueOak's GRC request, we have a redacted report and the full evidence bundle ready to be uploaded to their portal. Before we push anything, a couple quick clarifications so we meet the SOC 2 / SIG artifact requirements exactly:

- Redaction: we removed PII and customer-owned secrets; we left sample request/response traces with session tokens replaced by <REDACTED>. Will that format be acceptable for BlueOak's SOC 2 reviewers?
- Evidence index: we're producing a CSV manifest (filename: blueoak_evidence_index_v3.csv) that maps artifact -> evidence type -> path -> sampling notes. Does BlueOak prefer SHA256 hashes included in the index for each file?
- Portal upload: we can either upload directly to the GRC portal via their web UI or push an S3 manifest that BlueOak IT pulls into their intake pipeline. Which do you prefer?

Planned artifacts to deliver: redacted report (PDF), raw logs (zipped, with sensitive fields redacted), sample exploit repro scripts (obfuscated), screenshots, and the evidence index.

We can make the report available for download once you confirm redaction style and chosen upload method.

Attachments (stubs): BlueOak_PT_Report_2027-10-31_redacted.pdf, blueoak_evidence_index_v3.csv

Thanks,
Alex Vega
PenTest Ops Lead
RedCap Security
ops@redcapsec.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ops@redcapsec.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOak — final PT package and upload questions

Alex — thanks for the heads up and congrats on wrapping the engagement. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Redaction style: BlueOak's GRC team requires PII + customer identifiers removed and any internal IP addresses tokenized. The <REDACTED> placeholders you mentioned are fine, but please replace raw IPs with the prefix IP_xxx format (e.g., IP_10.0.3.7 -> IP_10.x.x.x) so automated reviewers can parse.
- Hashes in index: yes — please include SHA256 for each artifact; BlueOak will use them to validate integrity during intake.
- Upload path: please submit via the BlueOak GRC portal link (I've added it below) as a primary method; for larger archives you may provide an S3 manifest as a fallback. If you choose portal upload, ensure filenames follow the pattern: BlueOak_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>.<ext>.

I've looped in Marcus to confirm that no sensitive telemetry (stack traces with secrets) remain in logs. Once Marcus gives the go-ahead, Vanessa and I will coordinate the GRC intake.

Portal link for upload: https://grc.blueoak.com/upload/session/ABCD-1234
Redaction checklist: attached (redaction_checklist_v2.pdf)

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ops@redcapsec.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOak — final PT package and upload questions

Thanks — I reviewed a sample of the redacted logs Alex shared on the SFTP. A few technical notes before you upload the full set: 

1) Logs: remove or mask any JVM/system environment variables that may include customer-managed secrets or cloud role ARNs. A quick grep for "arn:aws" and "SECRET_" should catch the common patterns.
2) Screenshots: ensure any browser-based screenshots have username and email fields blurred; the GRC intake flags raw emails in images.
3) Exploit repros: if you include Proof-of-Concept scripts, please obfuscate any credentials or tokens and add a short README describing intended use and required environment.
4) Evidence indexing: include a 'classification' column in the CSV: {"report","log","screenshot","poctest","config"} so BlueOak's mapping can be automated.

Once the artifacts include those adjustments, I'm good with the portal upload. Neha, can you confirm retention rules for this upload and whether we should set an expiry on shared links?

- Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer — Runtime & Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: audits@blueoak.com <audits@blueoak.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ops@redcapsec.com
Cc: security@blueoak.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOak — final PT package and upload questions

Grace / Alex,

Thanks for coordinating. A couple of requests from BlueOak audit: 

- Please include SHA256 hashes in the manifest (confirmed).
- For the SOC 2 evidence binder, we need a short attestation from RedCap that the report has been redacted per BlueOak requirements (template attached in portal).
- Please flag any remediation items that require long-term tracking (we will want JIRA keys or a remediation CSV).

You can upload to the session link (ABCD-1234). If you encounter portal timeouts for the 4GB+ archive, send the S3 manifest and we will pull from your bucket.

Best,
Meera Patel
BlueOak — Audit Team
audits@blueoak.com
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ops@redcapsec.com, audits@blueoak.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOak — final PT package and upload questions

All — final status update from Redwood.

- Alex: please proceed with portal upload using the filename pattern and include SHA256 in blueoak_evidence_index_v3.csv. Marcus verified redaction guidance; I've attached Redwood's redaction_checklist_v2.pdf for reference.
- Evidence retention: Neha confirms the files should be retained for 90 days in the intake portal, after which BlueOak will manage archival. If you provide an S3 manifest, please mark objects with lifecycle: 90-day retention.
- Remediation mapping: we've asked RedCap to include a remediation.csv with columns: issue_id, short_desc, severity, status, jira_key (if open), target_date. BlueOak will ingest this into their tracker.

Next steps: Alex/RedCap to upload by COB Monday 11/22. Vanessa will run intake and confirm import into BlueOak's binder. If any of you need a short attestation template for SOC 2 evidence, use the portal doc at: https://docs.redwood.com/spreadsheets/sig-mapping-blueoak (we added the template on tab 'attestation').

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
